elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: Vendor expressly “shall defend and indemnify Customer and its Affiliates.”

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: The clause covers Customer and its Affiliates against “any third-party claim” arising from the listed events.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) covers allegations that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) expressly covers Vendor’s breach of Applicable Law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Subsection (d) expressly covers Vendor’s gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The indemnified Party must give the indemnifying Party written notice of the claim.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: The indemnifying Party is expressly given control of the defence and settlement.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The indemnified Party must provide reasonable cooperation.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: The clause states that Customer’s “only indemnity obligation” concerns Customer-provided content or Customer’s breach of Applicable Law.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: Vendor must indemnify Customer against third-party claims alleging that Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-modification exclusion is included; therefore the permitted exclusion does not restrict the indemnity.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No Customer-combination exclusion is included; therefore the permitted exclusion does not restrict the indemnity.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion is included; therefore the permitted exclusion does not restrict the indemnity.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: No operative language requires Vendor to procure continued use, modify, or replace. Section 9.3’s reference to remedies required by Section 20.5 does not itself create those duties, and no Section 20.5 remedy language is supplied.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no obligation to refund applicable Fees when other IP remedies are unavailable.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: No three-times-annual-Fees cap appears; Section 21.3 instead categorizes indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims.
